rca of the issue: Brute-force lockout RCA: auth_router keys attempts by identifier = request.client.host + username (+ optional client_id). In this ingress/proxy deployment, effective client host may not be stable/consistent for repeated external requests, so accumulated failures may not hit the same identifier bucket; result observed was 401 for all six attempts instead of 429. Reproduction: send 6 bad /api/auth/login attempts with same username from external URL; expected final 429, observed [401,401,401,401,401,401]. Mitigation: use trusted forwarded client IP (or secondary stable key) for identifier construction in proxied deployments. Native compile RCA: :app:compileDebugKotlin fails immediately with missing SDK location (ANDROID_HOME/local.properties absent), and direct kotlinc module typecheck with android-all jar still has unresolved AndroidX refs without full Android toolchain/dependency resolution; therefore only pure JVM class tests were executable here.
